body:
Founder tested the shipped v0 and found two real bugs plus one missing v0-shaping affordance. (1) Face-dragging was inverted -- root cause: closestPointOnAxisLineToRay defined w0 = linePoint - rayOrigin, the negation of the standard reference's own r = P1 - P2 (Ericson, Real-Time Collision Detection). Rederived directly against the reference, verified numerically with a standalone script before deploying (dragging toward +X now increases the face x-coordinate). (2) Added an object/face edit-mode toggle: object mode drags a whole cube (camera-facing-plane intersection, same 'billboard drag' technique as free 3D object translation everywhere), face mode is the original per-face reshape. (3) Added a movable spawner marker (session-only, not persisted level data) -- new cubes now spawn at the marker's position instead of a fixed default, fixing cubes always landing on top of each other. Also answered directly: no, the native SHANKPIT map loader was never shipped -- the backend Export endpoint produces the correct JSON but packages/map/map.c has no JSON-loading path yet. tsc -b && vite build / oxlint clean. Built, deployed, verified. Commit a2d4e3b.

⚓ ☃
title: S459: fix inverted face-drag sign, add object/face mode + movable spawner
